lines.text: The burden targets Hadrach, Damascus, Hamath, Tyre and Sidon, and the Lord will cast Tyre's wealth into the sea.
Gaza will lose her king, a mixed race will occupy Ashdod, and the Philistines will become like a clan in Judah.
The King comes to Zion righteous, victorious and humble, riding on a donkey, and the LORD will camp around His house.
The King will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, break the bow of war, and rule from sea to sea and from the Nile.
The LORD will rouse the sons of Zion against the sons of Egypt, and the LORD of Hosts will shield them.
